verses.original: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ καὶ αὐτῆς τοῖς τέκνοις οὓς ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: Ho presbyteros Eklektē kyria kai autēs tois teknois hous egō agapō en alētheia kai ouk egō monos alla kai pantes hoi egnōkotes tēn alētheian
verses.literal: The elder To [the] chosen lady and her - children whom I love in [the] truth and not I alone but also all who know the truth

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ἔσται μεθ’ ἡμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: dia tēn alētheian tēn menousan en hēmin kai estai meth’ hēmōn eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us vvv vvv forever

verses.original: χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρός καὶ παρὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Πατρός Ἔσται μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: charis eleos eirēnē para Theou Patros kai para Iēsou Christou tou Huiou tou Patros Estai meth’ hēmōn en alētheia kai agapē
verses.literal: Grace mercy [and] peace from God [the] Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father will be with us in truth and love

verses.original: Ἐχάρην λίαν ὅτι εὕρηκα ἐκ σου τῶν τέκνων περιπατοῦντας ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καθὼς παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός ἐντολὴν ἐλάβομεν
verses.transliteration: Echarēn lian hoti heurēka ek sou tōn teknōn peripatountas en alētheia kathōs para tou Patros entolēn elabomen
verses.literal: I was overjoyed . . . to find [some] of your - children walking in [the] truth just as - the Father has commanded [us]

verses.original: καὶ νῦν ἐρωτῶ σε κυρία οὐχ ὡς καινὴν ἐντολὴν γράφων σοι ἀλλὰ ἣν εἴχομεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: kai nyn erōtō se kyria ouch hōs kainēn entolēn graphōn soi alla hēn eichomen ap’ archēs hina agapōmen allēlous
verses.literal: And now I urge you [dear] lady not as a new commandment - to you but [one] we have had from [the] beginning that we love one another

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη ἵνα περιπατῶμεν κατὰ αὐτοῦ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὕτη ἐστιν ἡ καθὼς ἐντολή ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἵνα περιπατῆτε ἐν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: kai hautē estin hē agapē hina peripatōmen kata autou tas entolas hautē estin hē kathōs entolē ēkousate ap’ archēs hina peripatēte en autē
verses.literal: And this is - love that we walk according to His - commandments This is the very commandment you have heard from [the] beginning that you must walk in [love]

verses.original: Ὅτι πολλοὶ πλάνοι ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸν κόσμον οἱ μὴ ὁμολογοῦντες ἐρχόμενον Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκί οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πλάνος καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος
verses.transliteration: Hoti polloi planoi exēlthon eis ton kosmon hoi mē homologountes erchomenon Iēsoun Christon en sarki houtos estin ho planos kai ho antichristos
verses.literal: For many deceivers have gone out into the world - refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in [the] flesh Any such [ person ] is the deceiver and the antichrist

verses.original: βλέπετε ἑαυτούς ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσητε ἃ εἰργασάμεθα ἀλλὰ ἀπολάβητε πλήρη μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: blepete heautous hina mē apolesēte ha eirgasametha alla apolabēte plērē misthon
verses.literal: Watch yourselves so that vvv you do not lose what we have worked for but [that] you may be fully rewarded . . . . . .

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ προάγων καὶ μὴ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ οὐκ ἔχει Θεὸν ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ οὗτος ἔχει καὶ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν
verses.transliteration: pas ho proagōn kai mē menōn en tē didachē tou Christou ouk echei Theon ho menōn en tē didachē houtos echei kai ton Patera kai ton Huion
verses.literal: Anyone who runs ahead - without remaining in the teaching - of Christ vvv does not have God Whoever remains in [His] teaching - has both the Father and the Son

verses.original: Εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐ φέρει ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν μὴ λαμβάνετε αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν μὴ καὶ λέγετε χαίρειν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ei tis erchetai pros hymas kai ou pherei tautēn tēn didachēn mē lambanete auton eis oikian mē kai legete chairein autō
verses.literal: If anyone comes to you [but] vvv does not bring this - teaching {do} not receive him into [your] home [or] even greet . . . him

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ λέγων χαίρειν αὐτῷ κοινωνεῖ τοῖς αὐτοῦ τοῖς πονηροῖς ἔργοις
verses.transliteration: gar ho legōn chairein autō koinōnei tois autou tois ponērois ergois
verses.literal: - Whoever greets . . . [such a person] shares in his - evil deeds

verses.original: ἔχων Πολλὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐβουλήθην οὐκ διὰ χάρτου καὶ μέλανος ἀλλὰ ἐλπίζω γενέσθαι καὶ λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς στόμα πρὸς στόμα ἵνα ἡμῶν ἡ χαρὰ ᾖ πεπληρωμένη
verses.transliteration: echōn Polla graphein hymin eboulēthēn ouk dia chartou kai melanos alla elpizō genesthai kai lalēsai pros hymas stoma pros stoma hina hēmōn hē chara ē peplērōmenē
verses.literal: I have many things to write to you [but] I would prefer not [to do so] with paper and ink Instead I hope to come and speak with you [face] to [face] so that our - joy may be complete

verses.original: τὰ τέκνα σου τῆς ἐκλεκτῆς τῆς ἀδελφῆς Ἀσπάζεταί σε
verses.transliteration: ta tekna sou tēs eklektēs tēs adelphēs Aspazetai se
verses.literal: The children of your - elect - sister send you greetings . . .
